channels.name: ru.pedestrian_with_white_cane_or_guide_animal
channels.method: retained original person identity and cane/assistant source context with independent pixel review
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

channels.name: drv.approaching
channels.method: same-tick original ego/person pose, speed and longitudinal closure
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

channels.name: rel.centre_distance
channels.method: same-tick original ego/person pose and body geometry
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

channels.name: drv.stopped
channels.method: same-tick original ego velocity and stop interval
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

channels.name: kin.accel_longitudinal
channels.method: finite difference of original ego velocity at 20 Hz
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

channels.name: drv.time_to_conflict
channels.method: original relative pose and velocity with stated diagnostic assumptions
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

channels.name: ru.subject
channels.method: original actor IDs, roles and driver viewpoint source
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

channels.name: rel.contact
channels.method: original body geometry and any original contact event, separately reviewed
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

channels.name: rel.surface_gap
channels.method: original ego/person body geometry and lateral/longitudinal clearance
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

channels.name: vehicle_person_pose
channels.method: original Native vehicle and pedestrian actor pose and speed
channels.reference_frame: surveyed mountain road and original Native frame
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; marker appearance and blindness unverified

context_inputs.name: blind_person_source_context
context_inputs.method: retained source request with independent review flags

limitations: White or red-tipped cane and blindness require independent source and pixel review

cameras.name: overview

cameras.name: approach
cameras.pose_strategy: ego approach and pedestrian contact region

cameras.pose_strategy: cane marker or assistant and clearance

cameras.pose_strategy: driver view of person and stopping region
